description: Hewlett-Packard于2001年推出的数码相机。配备5-element lens; F2.8; TTL auto focus; 6.8 mm (equivalent to a 43mm lens on a 35 mm conventional film camera)。快门速度1.4 ms to 320 ms。使用JPEG。有效像素2.31。

specs.英文简介: The HP PhotoSmart 318 is a 2001 digital camera from Hewlett-Packard, with a 2x digital zoom and a 2.3 megapixel (MP) resolution sensor.
